name: pack-cli
description: Local command-line tools for authoring and validating learning packs.

scripts.lint: oxlint && oxfmt --config ../../.oxfmtrc.json --check src test package.json tsconfig.json oxlint.config.ts vitest.config.ts
scripts.lint:fix: oxlint --fix && oxfmt --config ../../.oxfmtrc.json --write src test package.json tsconfig.json oxlint.config.ts vitest.config.ts
scripts.verify: pnpm lint:fix && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test
